manifest.title: Labeler
manifest.author: Melody Kelly
manifest.description:
## About

This app reads the Stripe API key and provides a button to generate a spreadsheet
and printable labels for shipping items

manifest.postInstallMessage:
# Post Installation
## Set the Environment Variables

After installing, you will need to set the `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`

```bash
export LABELER_APP_ID=000-aaa # you can get this from the cloudron web interface
# You need npm installed
npx cloudron env set --app $LABELER_APP_ID STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_...
```
